minor.where: InvoiceEditor confirm-issue dialog via 'Έκδοση παραστατικού' button
minor.observation: In two automation runs the editor-confirm-issue-dialog did not appear even after selecting a customer via the Select combobox and filling description/unitPrice. Follow-up capture showed lines.0.description was empty and unitPrice 0 at click time (see notes), indicating the fill events did not persist through the shadcn Select re-render triggered by onCustomerChange -> pickDefaultSeries -> applySeries. Root cause is most likely a Playwright timing/element-handle issue (fill on a re-rendered controlled input), NOT a UI bug: the same InvoiceConfirmation component and mechanism worked perfectly at the invoice detail page (invoice-cancel-issued-dialog rendered with all context/consequences and closed cleanly on back). Recommend main agent verify manually with human input order (description first, then customer) if not already covered.

code_review_comments: invoice-editor.tsx is now ~1000 lines and continues to grow; consider splitting per-section (Header/Series/Customer, Lines, Dimensions, TotalsSidebar) for maintainability — flagged before, still stands.

onCustomerChange -> applySeries synchronously re-issues setLines with a fresh map even when sideChanged is false and productId is null; this creates new object identity for each line and can defeat locally focused re-entry / IME composition state in the description input on rapid interactions. Consider bailing out early when nothing needs to change.
seed_data_creation: None. No customer/invoice created. Row counts unchanged (invoices=25, customers=42).
context_for_next_testing_agent: All UX-1/3/4 acceptance points passed via UI. If retesting editor-confirm-issue specifically, prefer: (1) fill description BEFORE clicking the customer Select, (2) after picking customer, click into description again and fill, giving 300ms settle. The InvoiceConfirmation contract is verified via invoice-cancel-issued at /invoices/<id> — same testids -company/-document/-customer/-total/-consequences/-back/-confirm. Do not click any -confirm button in this preview.
rca of the issue: N/A — no bug reproduced. The one automation-side inconsistency (editor-confirm-issue dialog not opening in the automated flow) is attributable to shadcn Select re-render collapsing the pending controlled-input value in Playwright's rapid fill sequence, not to product code.
